## Summary
A concise description of the changes made and the problem being solved.

## Conventional Commit Type
Please ensure your PR title follows Conventional Commits: `<type>(<scope>): <description>`:
- [ ] `feat`: New feature / capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `refactor`: Structural refactoring
- [ ] `test`: Test suite additions
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance / metadata

## Verification Steps
- [ ] Ran `node --test tests/**/*.test.mjs` (All tests pass)
- [ ] Ran `node scripts/validate-commit.mjs` on sample commits
- [ ] Checked documentation and cross-references
